newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin expresses concern for those living in poverty and urges state-owned enterprises to step up reform.
- Central bank to increasingly rely on open market operations and to move away from administrative measures to control money supply, deputy governor Chen Yaoxian says.
- Details of planned 3.5 billion yuan ($421 million) railway bond issue unveiled; 2.0 billion yuan would have a three-year maturity while the remainder would be for five years.
- Guangdong Development Bank starts to repay debts for Zhongyin Trust and Investment.
- Huge imports cause domestic newsprint firms losses.
- Bank of Communications profits reach 5.375 billion yuan in 1996
- China Construction Bank bans loans to shell projects and luxury hotels.
- Institutional players behind stock boom in 1996, says editorial.
